name: Customer service representatives
oneLiner: The clearest case of AI eating the entry rung rather than the ladder.
why: Front-line resolution of routine enquiries is exactly what agents do well
Volume is high and the interaction is text or voice, both native to AI

claims.text: Customer service representatives are among the most affected occupations in Microsoft's usage-based analysis.

Early-career workers aged 22–25 in the most AI-exposed occupations — including customer service representatives and software developers — now sit 19% below their kept-pace path (15% a year earlier), while experienced workers in the same occupations stayed stable.
Employment declines concentrate in applications where AI automates work rather than augments it.
